$comment: Method-and-capture evidence backing every reader-facing candidacy field in thesis-candidacy.json. Each criterion records what was measured, where, how, when (UTC), what was excluded, what was found, and where a stranger can re-check. Negative results are scoped to the defined search, never asserted as exhaustive. Refreshing this file is a reviewed action, not part of any build.

independentIntegrations.definition: A public repository, package, or application that reads /registry/zodiacs.registry.json or depends on @zodiacs/sdk and is not operated by Zodiacs.org, Astrofolio, or the SDK’s own examples.
sourcesSearched: web search: "@zodiacs/sdk" OR "zodiacs.registry.json" -site:zodiacs.org (no consumers found; results were the unrelated Gnosis Zodiac tooling)
grep.app code search: attempted, blocked by a bot checkpoint — recorded as an unsearched source
independentIntegrations.method: Package-registry lookup plus keyword search for the two machine-readable identifiers a consumer must reference. npm exposes no public dependents API; dependents were checked only via the searches above.
independentIntegrations.capturedAtUtc: 2026-07-23T04:05:00Z to 2026-07-23T04:20:00Z (session window; npm responses saved verbatim in the closeout notes)
independentIntegrations.exclusions: Zodiacs.org properties, Astrofolio properties, @zodiacs/sdk’s own examples, owner-controlled accounts.
independentIntegrations.result: No qualifying results found in the defined search. Not exhaustive: private, unpublished, or unindexed integrations would not be found, and one code-search source was unavailable.

thirdPartyCitations.definition: An editorial mention of zodiacs.org or one of its twelve canonical mint addresses by an independent publication, i.e. written by a person rather than generated from chain data.
sourcesSearched: web search: "zodiacs.org" -site:zodiacs.org registry OR thesis OR zodiac tokens
web search: "GhFiFrExPY3proVF96oth1gESWA5QPQzdtb8cy8b1YZv" OR "8Cd7wXoPb5Yt9cUGtmHNqAEmpMDrhfcVqnGbLC48b8Qm" (aries and leo canonical mints)
thirdPartyCitations.method: Search-engine queries for the site and for two canonical mint addresses as citation anchors; every hit classified as editorial, automated listing, or owner-adjacent.
thirdPartyCitations.exclusions: Astrofolio properties (owner-adjacent by counting rule regardless of control); automated wallet/aggregator listings (Solflare price pages, CryptoDB dataset record) — observed, listed below, not counted.
thirdPartyCitations.result: No qualifying editorial citations found in the defined searches. Observed and excluded: Solflare auto-generated price pages for the aries and leo mints; a CryptoDB dataset record. Not exhaustive: two search queries cannot cover all publications; the other ten mints were not individually queried.

holderDispersion.definition: Median and range of per-sign top-10 token-account share, from the repository’s weekly public distribution snapshots (public/assets/distribution.json, refreshed by the distribution-refresh workflow).
sourcesSearched: git history of public/assets/distribution.json on origin/main
holderDispersion.method: git show <sha>:public/assets/distribution.json for every commit touching the file; per snapshot, median and min–max of signs[*].top10Pct.
holderDispersion.capturedAtUtc: 2026-07-23T04:30:00Z (extraction); snapshot dates are the capturedAt fields inside each committed file
holderDispersion.exclusions: None; all four existing snapshots used.
holderDispersion.result: Four weekly snapshots exist: 2026-06-29 median 26.62% (range 23.2–28.9), 2026-07-06 median 26.62% (23.2–28.9), 2026-07-13 median 27.16% (23.0–30.6), 2026-07-20 median 27.16% (23.0–30.6). Baseline established; no widening — the median moved slightly toward concentration.

liquidityPersistence.definition: Whether each sign’s canonical Raydium pool (the reviewed pool addresses published in the instrument disclosure) exists and holds liquidity at capture, plus the pool-creation date Dexscreener reports.
sourcesSearched: Dexscreener token endpoint per canonical mint: https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/tokens/{mint}
liquidityPersistence.method: One API call per mint; the canonical pool is matched by the reviewed pool address; liquidity.usd, volume.h24, and pairCreatedAt recorded per pool. The twelve per-pool records are embedded below.
liquidityPersistence.exclusions: Non-canonical pools (stray Meteora pairs) observed but not counted toward the canonical-pool claim.
liquidityPersistence.result: 12 of 12 canonical pools live at the capture with $11.9k–17.8k liquidity and $10–158 of 24h volume; Dexscreener reports pair creation 2024-07-05 for all twelve. Continuous historical depth between creation and capture was NOT archived and is not claimed.

archiveContinuity.definition: Count, earliest, latest, and largest day-gap of HTTP-200 Internet Archive captures of zodiacs.org since 2024-01-01 (one per day via collapse), plus the repository’s own continuously versioned archive.
archiveContinuity.method: One CDX query; the raw response rows are embedded below; the gap statistic is computed from consecutive capture dates.
archiveContinuity.exclusions: Pre-2024 captures of the domain (predate the registry; the domain had unrelated prior history) and non-200 captures.
archiveContinuity.result: 9 captures since 2024-01-01; earliest 20240726, latest 20250719; largest gap 166 days (20240804 → 20250117); no capture in the 12 months before the query. The repository’s own version archive is continuous and independently verifiable through its public commit history.
